run_ensure_ollama_and_model: run ensure_ollama_and_model to install Ollama, start the server, and download the specified model if needed
test_is_ollama_installed: test is_ollama_installed to check if the Ollama CLI is available on the current system
run_start_ollama_server: run start_ollama_server to launch the Ollama server process and wait until it becomes available
run_download_model: run download_model to pull a named Ollama model from the registry with progress bar output
run_delete_model: run delete_model to remove a locally downloaded Ollama model using the CLI rm command
